title: R2-SEC4: wrl.14 opinion
description: wrl.14: Sender Behavior paragraph in Peer/receipt (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md:304-306). The paragraph is dense because 'the sending server' for Peer/receipt is the original message recipient's mailbox — a role inversion that is inherently confusing. The existing parenthetical '(the recipient of the original message, whose read event is being reported — not the original message sender)' does explain the role correctly. SEC7 labeled this opinion in R1. On re-read, the paragraph is technically correct; the parenthetical is the fix. No implementor-impacting ambiguity remains. Opinion-level.
